rule1: Registrations are open between {registrationOpenDate} and {registrationClosedDate} or until the maximum capacity of {maxRegistration} projects is reached.
rule2: A participant is between {minAge} and {maxAge} years old at the date of the event and is a resident of Belgium.
rule3: All projects are welcome, from beginner to advanced. All technologies are acceptable (even unfinished projects).
rule4: After registration, the participant receives a confirmation mail.  You need to click on the link to make sure the registration is confirmed.
rule5: You can collaborate with a maximum of 4 participants on one project. All participants need to register. First, the project owner registers the project. After confirmation, other participants can join this project after receiving an invitation mail from the project owner with a registration token.
rule6: For a valid entry, you have to send in a 3 to 5 pictures of your project. These pictures has to reach us before {projectClosedDate} 23:59h.
rule7: After registration, participants can change the user information on the project. Only the project owner can change his project information. All changes to the project registration have to be final on {projectClosedDate}.
rule8: On {officialStartDate} we expect you to be available to present your project at Technopolis in Mechelen.
rule9: We only provide a goodie to registered participants who send in a project pictures and are showcasing on {officialStartDate}.
rule10a: a. All personal data we collect are required for us to organize the event. These personal data, with the exemption of the email address of the guardian or +16-year-old participant and the year of participation, will be removed from our systems 6 months after the end date of the event. Aggregated data, void from personal data, are kept for statistical and reporting purposes.
rule10b: b. By registering for Coolest Projects, you agree that we can use your project data and pictures on our website and social media for promoting future events.
rule10d: (For additional information, you can consult our privacy statement on the CoderDojo Belgium website {privacy_link}.)
